overall_assessment: Section extraction for inn is largely correct: learning outcomes are complete, arbeidskrav/obligatoriske aktiviteter land in coursework_requirements, 'Ingen' prerequisites are dropped, and all 14 suspects (Praksisstudium courses, pass/fail) are false alarms (leak->* flags come from bullet topic lines such as 'Arbeidsmåter og vurderingsformer'; 'boilerplate' is the genuine, identical pass/fail assessment text). One real loss: the nynorsk heading 'Ferdighetsmål' is unmapped and its skills outcomes vanish. Minor noise: flattened exam table line in assessment, dropped Kunnskap/Ferdigheter sub-headings, and the generic Praksis paragraph in teaching_methods.

findings.description: In the nynorsk plan the learning-outcome groups are headed Kunnskapsmål / Ferdighetsmål / Generell kompetanse. 'Ferdighetsmål' maps to nothing, so its six skills outcomes ('kan bruke kunnskap om språk og språkutvikling i norskopplæringa ...') are absent from the extracted learning_outcomes, which jumps from the knowledge group straight to the general-competence group. A whole third of the learning outcomes is lost.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R has a pattern for 'Kunnskap(smål)' but none for 'Ferdighetsmål' (only 'Ferdigheter'); the unmapped heading's text is then dropped rather than appended to learning_outcomes.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'Ferdighetsmål' (and nynorsk variants 'Ferdigheitsmål', 'Kunnskapsmål', 'Generell kompetanse') as sub-headings mapped to learning_outcomes in R/section_heading_map.R; also check what happens to text under unmapped headings, which should not be silently lost.

findings.evidence: Muntlig eksamen ECTS - A-F Individuell Tillatte hjelpemidler til eksamen Kunnskapsløftet
findings.description: Every assessment begins with the exam table flattened to one line: the header row is gone but the data row (exam form, grade scale, group/individual, duration, aids) remains as run-together logistics, e.g. 'Skriftlig eksamen med tilsyn ECTS - A-F Individuell 5 Time(r) Dictionary Digital ordliste...'. It is exam logistics, not narrative assessment, and partly duplicates the following sentence ('Individuell muntlig eksamen'). The section is correct but not clean.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Table rows are flattened by the block reader (R/blocks.R) and .clean_sections() in R/extract_sections.R does not recognise the row.
findings.suggested_fix: Read the exam table as a table block and drop it (or store it as separate structured columns) when building the assessment section, or strip the first line of assessment when it contains 'ECTS - A-F'.

findings.description: Content is complete, but the sub-headings Kunnskap / Ferdigheter / Generell kompetanse are consumed and replaced by a bare repeated 'Studenten' line, so the knowledge/skills/general-competence structure is lost.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Sub-headings are absorbed by the section splitter in R/extract_sections.R without being emitted into the text.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the sub-heading lines as text inside learning_outcomes (or a consistent marker) instead of dropping them.

findings.evidence: Praksisstudiet er en integrert del av fagene som inngår i utdanningen. Alle fag i utdanningen har sammen med praksisstudiet ansvar for at studentene utvikler identitet som lærer.
findings.description: The 'Praksis' sub-block under Arbeids- og undervisningsformer is identical generic text across subject courses and is appended to teaching_methods along with the stray word 'Praksis'; it is not course-specific teaching-method content and dilutes the section.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No section_heading_map pattern for a standalone 'Praksis' heading, so it continues the preceding teaching_methods section.
findings.suggested_fix: Map a standalone 'Praksis' heading to .drop (or strip the shared paragraph in .clean_sections()), keeping it only if course-specific practice organisation is wanted.
